newsitem.title: GERMANY: DHL night-time pick-up, next-day delivery.
newsitem.headline: DHL night-time pick-up, next-day delivery.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express said it has started offering night-time pick-up and next day delivery in a trial scheme in Germany.
Clients in Frankfurt can now give goods ranging from documents to spare parts to couriers between 20:00 and 07:00, a company statement said.
These are flown on the early morning flights of partner Deutsche Lufthansa AG to 27 European cities and New York for same-day delivery.
The service costs standard DHL rates with a 160 mark extra charge for the night-time pick-up. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
